verdict.rationale: Brex documents itself as a unified platform covering corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel and bill pay [brex-docs-26]. It also offers banking through a business account [brex-docs-27, brex-docs-10] and vendor payments by ACH, wire and check [brex-docs-12, brex-docs-7]. Its MCP server spans expenses, cards, banking transactions and bills in one account [brex-docs-21]. However, founder reports show that eligibility limits whether a founder can actually consolidate here: Brex exited the small-business market [brex-comm-13, brex-comm-14], imposed higher cash minimums on non-VC-backed companies [brex-comm-15], repeatedly rejected bank-account applications [brex-comm-10], and in one case required connecting an outside business bank account during signup [brex-comm-16]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that teams actually replaced separate spend, bill-pay and banking tools with Brex; broad founder eligibility (small and non-VC-backed companies are restricted).
